title: Smart Data Models - Project Haystack - Point
description: Data point such as a sensor or actuator. See the Haystack 'Points' chapter chapter. (Project Haystack 4.0.0 entity 'point', Xeto spec ph::Point. Tag names verbatim; marker tags in hasTag.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity. Stands for the Haystack 'id' Ref tag.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Point'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasTag.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#hasTag'. The marker tags of the entity, verbatim Haystack tag names, as Haystack's own RDF export encodes markers (ph:hasTag). Must contain 'point'. It carries the entity subtype markers (e.g. point), the options chosen for Haystack choices and any other marker such as his, cur, writable or hvac. Values expand to the Haystack def IRIs in JSON-LD. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/docHaystack/Rdf#instances. Marker tags that Haystack declares on point: cur, his, hisTotalized, writable

dis.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#dis'. Display name for an entity. See the Haystack 'Ontology' chapter chapter. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/dis

curErr.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#curErr'. Error description when 'curStatus' indicates error condition. Applies to point entities of type cur-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/curErr

curStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#curStatus'. Status of point's current value reading. The 'curVal' is only available when curStatus is "ok" or "stale". However a "stale" value should be used with caution since the local system does not have a fresh value. It is recommended that the 'curVal' tag is removed from a point when the curStatus is not "ok" nor "stale". Values: ok: all is okay; stale: the point's curVal is not fresh data; fault: a configuration or hardware problem - see `curErr`; down: a communication or network problem - see `curErr`; disabled: manual disable of the point or connector; unknown: we don't know anything (usually boot state); remoteFault: point in remote system is fault; remoteDown: point in remote system is down; remoteDisabled: point in remote system is disabled; remoteUnknown: point in remote system is unknown. Applies to point entities of type cur-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/curStatus

curVal.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#curVal'. Current value of a point. The current value is only available when the 'curStatus' is "ok" or "stale". Number values are in the point's 'unit'. Applies to point entities of type cur-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/curVal

enum.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#enum'. Defines an eumeration of string key names. The range may also be applied to format a Bool ordered as "false,true". The value of this tag may be formatted in one of five ways: - dict of dicts keyed by name and Dict values for meta such as 'doc' tag - comma separated names on one line - names separated by a "\n" newline character - markdown unordered list formatted as a series of "- name: description\n" - ref to a Xeto 'sys::Enum' spec Enum names should follow valid tag naming rules (start with lowercase ASCII letter and contain only ASCII letters and numbers). However in cases where mapping directly to external enumerations enum names can contain arbitrary characters such as space. Here as a string of names separated by commas or newlines (the Haystack dict and Xeto-spec forms are not used). Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/enum

equipRef.description: Relationship. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#equipRef'. Reference to equip which contains this entity. Points to a Equip entity. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/equipRef

hisErr.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#hisErr'. Error description when 'hisStatus' indicates error condition. Applies to point entities of type his-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/hisErr

hisMode.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#hisMode'. Indicates the way that history data is collected for a point. Values: sampled: Data is sampled on a regular interval. The timestamp indicates exactly when the sample was taken, and we assume linear interpolation between samples.; cov: Data is logged when it changes. The means the timestamp indicates exactly when it changed (inclusive) and it remains that value until the next sample's timestamp (exclusive).; consumption: Integral data is sampled on a regular interval and logged at the *end* of the interval. The timestamp indicates the *end* of the interval. Therefore, the raw data is logged as start *exclusive*, end *inclusive*. This is mode is typical for consumption meters.. Applies to point entities of type his-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/hisMode

hisStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#hisStatus'. Status of point's history collection or synchronization. Values: ok: last sync attempt was successful; fault: a configuration problem - see `hisErr`; down: a communication or network problem - see `hisErr`; disabled: manual disable of the point or parent connector; unknown: we don't know anything (usually boot state); pending: sync has been scheduled and is waiting to running; syncing: sync is currently running. Applies to point entities of type his-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/hisStatus

kind.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#kind'. Kind name used to identity a value data type. Values: Marker: is-a label; Bool: true or false; NA: not available; Number: floating point with optional unit; Str: Unicode string; Uri: Universal resource identifier; Ref: reference to an entity; Date: an ISO 8601 date as year, month, day: 2011-06-07; Time: an ISO 8601 time as hour, minute, seconds: 09:51:27.354; DateTime: an ISO 8601 timestamp followed by timezone name; Coord: geographic coordinate in latitude/longitude formatted as C(lat,lng); XStr: extended string with type name; List: ordered sequence; Dict: key/value map; Grid: two dimensional tabular data collection. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/kind

maxVal.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#maxVal'. Inclusive maximum for a numeric value. In the point's 'unit'. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/maxVal

minVal.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#minVal'. Inclusive minimum for a numeric value. In the point's 'unit'. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/minVal

pointFunction.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#pointFunction'. Classifies the point as a sensor, command, or setpoint. See the Haystack 'Points' chapter chapter. Haystack choice: the value is one of its options, which is also a marker tag of the entity (listed in hasTag). Values are Haystack def names; in JSON-LD they expand to the def IRIs. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/pointFunction

pointQuantity.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#pointQuantity'. Quantity the point senses or controls. Haystack choice: the value is one of its options, which is also a marker tag of the entity (listed in hasTag). Values are Haystack def names; in JSON-LD they expand to the def IRIs. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/pointQuantity

pointRef.description: Relationship. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#pointRef'. See the Haystack 'Synthetics' chapter chapter. Points to a Point entity. Applies to point entities of type sim-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/pointRef

pointSubject.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#pointSubject'. What the point senses or controls. Haystack choice: the value is one of its options, which is also a marker tag of the entity (listed in hasTag). Values are Haystack def names; in JSON-LD they expand to the def IRIs. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/pointSubject

simScenario.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#simScenario'. See the Haystack 'Synthetics' chapter chapter. Haystack choice: the value is one of its options, which is also a marker tag of the entity (listed in hasTag). Values are Haystack def names; in JSON-LD they expand to the def IRIs. Applies to point entities of type sim-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/simScenario

siteRef.description: Relationship. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#siteRef'. Reference to site which contains the entity. Points to a Site entity. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/siteRef

spaceRef.description: Relationship. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#spaceRef'. Reference to space which contains this entity. Points to a Space entity. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/spaceRef

synthetic.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#synthetic'. Synthetic point with computed operational data. The computed data if classified as: - 'ml' for machine learning - 'sim' for simulation - 'computed' as catch all for other computations See the Haystack 'Synthetics' chapter chapter. Haystack choice: the value is one of its options, which is also a marker tag of the entity (listed in hasTag). Values are Haystack def names; in JSON-LD they expand to the def IRIs. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/synthetic

syntheticModelRef.description: Relationship. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#syntheticModelRef'. See the Haystack 'Synthetics' chapter chapter. Points to a Haystack 'syntheticModel' entity (not modelled in this candidate). Applies to point entities of type synthetic-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/syntheticModelRef

systemRef.description: Relationship. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#systemRef'. Reference to system. Points to a System entity. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/systemRef

tz.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#tz'. Timezone identifier from standard timezone database. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/tz

unit.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/ph/4.0.0#unit'. Unit identifier from standard unit database. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-ph/unit

weatherStationRef.description: Relationship. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#weatherStationRef'. Reference to weather station for to use this entity. Points to a WeatherStation entity. Applies to point entities of type weather-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/weatherStationRef

writeErr.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#writeErr'. Error description when 'writeStatus' indicates error condition. Applies to point entities of type writable-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/writeErr

writeLevel.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#writeLevel'. Current priority level for 'writeVal' as number between 1 and 17. The value 17 indicates the relinquish default value. Applies to point entities of type writable-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/writeLevel

writeStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#writeStatus'. Current status of a writable point output. Values: unbound: writable point is not bound to any output; ok: last write was successful; down: connectivity/networking problem - see `writeErr`; fault: configuration or hardware error - see `writeErr`; disabled: manual disable of the point or connector; unknown: we don't know anything (typically boot state). Applies to point entities of type writable-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/writeStatus

writeVal.description: Property. Model:'https://project-haystack.org/def/phIoT/4.0.0#writeVal'. Current desired value to write to output. This is the current "winning" value of the priority array indicated by 'writeLevel'. If this tag is missing then the winning value is null/auto. Number values are in the point's 'unit'. Applies to point entities of type writable-point. Documentation: https://project-haystack.org/doc/lib-phIoT/writeVal

marker.description: Haystack marker tags (non-conjunct marker defs of Haystack 4.0.0).

pointQuantity.description: Options of the Haystack choice 'pointQuantity' (subtypes of 'quantity').

pointSubject.description: Options of the Haystack choice 'pointSubject' (subtypes of 'phenomenon').
